settings.require_birth_date: Mystery person must have a birth date

settingsHelp.total_rounds: How many rounds one game has.
settingsHelp.max_score: Points awarded for a perfect guess. Higher means higher scores overall.
settingsHelp.max_extra_assets: Extra photos of the same spot shown as clues. Higher means more clues, easier.
settingsHelp.flat_score_radius_km: Guesses within this radius still score the max. Higher is more forgiving, easier.
settingsHelp.decay_km: How fast score drops per km past the max-score radius. Higher is more forgiving (slower decay), lower is harsher.
settingsHelp.flat_score_days: Guesses within this many days still score the max. Higher is more forgiving, easier.
settingsHelp.decay_days: How fast score drops per day past the max-score window. Higher is more forgiving (slower decay), lower is harsher.
settingsHelp.starting_score: Points a game starts with, before any wrong guesses. Higher gives more room to guess wrong.
settingsHelp.wrong_guess_penalty: Points lost per wrong guess. Higher is harsher.
settingsHelp.asset_count_weight: How much a person or album's photo count skews who gets picked (0 = uniform, 1 = fully proportional). Higher means well-photographed ones show up more.
settingsHelp.require_birth_date: Only pick a mystery person who has a birth date set.
settingsHelp.total_people: How many different people the whole game asks about. Higher means a longer game.
settingsHelp.max_hidden_faces: Max faces blacked out in a single round. Higher is harder.
settingsHelp.streak_scoring: Whether points award a flat amount per correct guess, or build a bonus the longer your streak goes.
settingsHelp.face_box_growth: How much bigger the blackout box is than the face itself (1.0 = tight fit). Higher covers more of the photo, harder.
settingsHelp.tolerance_days: How many days off a placed card can still count as correct. Higher is more forgiving, easier.
settingsHelp.min_separation_days: Minimum gap enforced between cards' dates when picking photos, so they don't cluster together. Higher spreads them further apart.
settingsHelp.max_cards: Cap on how many cards one run can reach (0 = unlimited).
settingsHelp.max_points: Points awarded for answering instantly. Higher means higher scores overall.
settingsHelp.min_points: Points awarded for a correct answer given right at the time limit, instead of 0. Higher rewards a slow-but-correct answer more.
settingsHelp.answer_time_seconds: Time limit to answer a question, in seconds. Higher gives more time, easier.
settingsHelp.max_rounds: Cap on how many rounds one run can reach (0 = unlimited).

settingsHelp.no_repeat_days: How many days a subject stays excluded from repeating in the daily challenge. Higher needs a bigger library.
settingsHelp.chain_length: How many rounds the day's challenge contains.
